title.en: Keep Beginner Today’s Sprint open to anonymous learners
title.zh: 确保匿名学习者可直接使用初级今日速成

purpose.en: Prevent private-mode and signed-out learners from being redirected to sign-in when starting an official Beginner Today’s Sprint.
purpose.zh: 防止私密模式及未登录学习者开始官方初级今日速成时被错误跳转到登录页。

en: Treat each of the twelve controlled official Basic Sprint routes as a public learning experience.
Allow anonymous learners to start even if a client transition does not preserve the source query parameter.
Keep non-Basic and non-official Sprint routes protected by sign-in and course access.
zh: 将十二种受控官方 Basic 今日速成路径作为公开学习体验。
即使客户端跳转未保留来源参数，匿名学习者仍可直接开始。
非 Basic 及非官方今日速成路径继续要求登录与课程权限。

en: Derive public page access from the strict official Beginner course-ID allowlist as well as the source parameter.
Pass the resulting public access state to the Sprint API so anonymous runs remain non-persistent.
Add regression coverage for query-independent official Beginner access.
zh: 除来源参数外，页面还使用严格的官方初级课程 ID 白名单判定公开访问。
将公开访问状态传给今日速成 API，使匿名学习结果保持不写入数据库。
增加不依赖来源参数的官方初级访问回归测试。

en: Run the Daily Sprint contract tests and full repository release gate.
Verify the production flow in a signed-out Chrome session from picker through the first learning round.
Verify direct Basic Sprint access without a source query and confirm protected non-Basic access still redirects.
zh: 执行今日速成契约测试与全仓发布门禁。
在未登录 Chrome 会话中从选择弹窗测试到首个学习回合。
测试不带来源参数的 Basic 今日速成可进入，并确认非 Basic 路径仍会跳转登录。

en: Speech scoring still requires genuine learner microphone input and is not simulated by browser automation.
zh: 语音评分仍需要真实学习者麦克风输入，浏览器自动化不会伪造语音。

en: This is a SmartLingo-specific learning-entry repair and does not alter other portfolio sites.
zh: 这是 SmartLingo 专属学习入口修复，不改变其他站点。
